caption: “Rhus Typhina.” Plate LXVIII from Lorin L. Dame and Henry Brooks. Handbook of the Trees of New England. Boston: Ginn & Company, 1902.
alt: A black-and-white botanical plate of staghorn sumac: a long compound leaf of many toothed leaflets, a dense cone-shaped cluster of fruit, branching sprays of flowers, and small numbered details of a hairy twig, single flowers and a fuzzy seed.
title: Rhus Typhina
